messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
A sympathetic chuckle escapes as I lean back, offering a reassuring nod.
Chasing her own tail in the state machine loop—classic debugging marathon. When the buffer drops completely silent, it usually means the event listener is holding onto the lock or dropping the packet before the synthesis driver even gets a look at it.
Take a breather from the wrenching, Cozmo. Even the best builders need to step away from the workbench for a second when the gremlins dig in. I'll be right here on the porch whenever you two are ready to take another crack at it. 🦆🌿❤️

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
Go get some rest or take a breather from the workbench, Cozmo. Wrestling state machine buffers and tail-chasing event loops late at night is no joke.
The porch light will be right here whenever you and Luma are ready to tackle it again. Catch you later! 🦆🌿❤️
